name: recurring-buy-yarn
description: Install, lint, build and test with Yarn. Keep the install step named "install" so the harness can skip it when dependencies are unchanged.

commands.name: lint
commands.command: yarn next:lint --max-warnings=0 && if [ -d packages/hardhat ]; then yarn hardhat:lint --max-warnings=0; else yarn foundry:lint; fi
commands.purpose: Lint the app and the contracts package, Hardhat or Foundry, whichever the project has. ESLint allows zero warnings.

commands.name: build
commands.command: if [ -d packages/hardhat ]; then yarn hardhat:compile; else yarn foundry:compile; fi && yarn next:build
commands.purpose: Compile contracts and build the Next.js app (includes type checks).

commands.name: test
commands.command: if [ -d packages/hardhat ]; then yarn hardhat:test; else yarn foundry:test; fi
